name: kuneco

scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:cc && npm run test:codex
scripts.test:docker: node scripts/test-docker-environments.mjs && node scripts/test-existing-container.mjs && node scripts/test-docker-proxy.mjs
